image_description: A guenon monkey (likely a Vervet or similar species) sitting on a wooden beam. The monkey has olive-green fur on its back, white chest and facial ruff, and a black face with white markings around the eyes and mouth. It is facing left, with its long tail extending behind it along the beam. The background is a blurred green foliage with a wire fence.

Eyes are forward-facing. Irises appear dark/brown, consistent with the species.
The nose structure is narrow and prominent, typical of Old World monkeys.
Ears are visible, small, and partially hidden by the facial ruff, matching the description.
